title: FATHER GOD, TURN TODAY'S TEARS INTO TOMORROW'S JOY
text: I want you to share this prayer with somebody. I want you to send this to someone who is in tears right now. Send this to somebody who has been crying in secret. Send this to that person whose pillow has become a witness to their midnight groaning. Share this with someone whose heart is broken, whose dream seems shattered, whose tomorrow looks darker than their today. The Lord wants to minister to them this morning. This is not just another prayer. This is a prophetic declaration over your life and over the lives of those you will send this to. So before we begin, I want you to take your phone and I want you to share this prayer. Share it on your status. Send it to that WhatsApp group. Send it to that friend who needs to hear from heaven this morning. The spirit of God is about to turn someone's sorrow into singing. And you will be the vessel through which that word comes. Glory to God. Father, we thank you this morning in the mighty name of Jesus. We thank you because you are the God who turns morning into dancing. We thank you because you are the God who wipes away tears. We thank you because your word declares in Psalm 30 to5 that weeping may endure for a night but joy comes in the morning. And father we declare that this is morning for someone. This is the morning of their joy. This is the morning of their breakthrough. This is the morning when their tears will be turned into testimonies in the mighty name of Jesus. Now I want you to understand something very critical this morning. The Bible says in Psalm 126:E5, "They that sow in tears shall reap in joy." There is a prophetic principle that I want you to grasp. Your tears are not wasted. Every tear you have cried has been documented in heaven. Psalm 56 to8 says, "You keep track of all my sorrows. You have collected all my tears in your bottle. You have recorded each one in your book." Do you know what this means? It means that God has been keeping record. Every night you cried yourself to sleep. Every moment you wept in secret, every tear that dropped from your eyes when people didn't understand your pain, God bottled them. He recorded them. And this morning, I prophesy to you that those tears are about to become the seed that produces your greatest harvest of joy. You see, there is something you must understand about the kingdom of God. In the kingdom, nothing is wasted. Your pain is not purposeless. Your tears are not meaningless. The very thing that has made you cry is the very thing that God is about to use to bring you your greatest celebration. The enemy thought he was destroying you, but God was developing you. The enemy thought he was finishing you, but God was fashioning you. The enemy thought your story was over, but God was writing the most powerful chapter of your testimony. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for every person hearing this prayer right now. Every person who has cried tears of disappointment, I decree and declare that your disappointment is being turned into divine appointment in the name of Jesus. Every person who has shed tears of rejection, I prophesy that God is bringing you into a season of divine acceptance. You will be accepted in places where you were once rejected. You will be celebrated in spaces where you were once humiliated. The stones that were thrown at you will become the foundation of your testimony in the mighty name of Jesus. Let me tell you what the Lord is showing me right now. I see people who have been crying because of financial devastation. I see people whose businesses have collapsed, whose careers have crumbled, whose sources of income have dried up. And the Lord says to tell you this morning that he's the God of suddenly. He is the God who turned the widow of Zarapath's last meal into an endless supply. He is the God who caused Isaac to sow in a time of famine and reap a hundfold in the same year. And the Lord says your suddenly has come. Your season of supernatural provision has arrived. The wealth that has eluded you. The favor that has been delayed. The open doors that have been shut. I prophesy that in this season, God is releasing them unto you in the name of Jesus. I prophesy to someone, your weeping is over. Your season of lack is terminated. Your days of begging are cancelled. Your nights of worry are finished. God is opening windows of heaven over your life that no man can shut. Resources are being released. Connections are being orchestrated. Divine helpers are being positioned. And before this year runs out, you will look back at this very moment and you will testify that God turned your tears into joy. You will testify that what the enemy meant for evil, God turned it around for your good. Father, I pray for those who have been weeping because of sickness and infirmity. Those whose bodies have become a source of pain, whose medical reports have become a source of fear, whose diagnosis has stolen their peace. Lord, you are Jehovah Rafa, the God who heals. You are the God who healed the leper, who opened blind eyes, who caused the lame to walk, who raised the dead. And I decree by the authority of heaven that every sickness attacking the bodies of those praying this prayer is destroyed right now in the mighty name of Jesus. >> Every terminal disease, I command you to bow. Every chronic condition, I command you to leave. Every pain that has refused to go, I decree that it is uprooted from the foundation in the name of Jesus. Let there be supernatural healing in bodies right now. Let there be restoration of organs. Let there be recreation of systems. Whatever the doctor said cannot be healed. I prophesy that the great physician is healing it now. Whatever medical science said is impossible, I decree that the God of impossibilities is making it possible. And those tears of pain are being turned into tears of praise. Those tears of sorrow are being converted into tears of celebration. You will dance again. You will laugh again. You will celebrate again in the mighty name of Jesus. Now hear me very clearly. There are some of you who have been crying not because of physical things but because of spiritual battles. You've been under attack. Your mind has been tormented. Your peace has been stolen. Your joy has been hijacked. You wake up with anxiety. You sleep with fear. The enemy has been projecting nightmares into your sleep. You've been having terrible dreams. You've been feeling oppressed, depressed, and suppressed. But I want you to know this morning that the battle is not yours. It is the Lord's. The Bible says in 2 Chronicles 20:15, "Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours, but God's." And this morning, I want you to understand that God is not just going to fight for you. He's going to fight as you. The greater one lives inside of you. The one who spoke and worlds came into existence dwells in you. The one who shut the mouths of lions, who quenched the violence of fire, who divided the Red Sea. That same God lives in you by the person of the Holy Spirit. So right now, I come against every spiritual attack. I come against every demonic assignment. I come against every witchcraft manipulation. I come against every satanic projection by the blood of Jesus, by the fire of the Holy Spirit, by the authority given to us through the name of Jesus Christ. I decree that every evil altar speaking against your life is dismantled right now. Every satanic covenant working against your destiny is broken right now. Every generational cost trying to limit your future is canled right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I pray that you will release your waring angels. Dispatch them to fight on behalf of your children. Let them surround everyone praying this prayer with walls of fire. Let them encamp around them as Psalm 34-7 declares, "The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him and delivers them. I decree angelic protection. I decree angelic intervention. I decree angelic warfare on behalf of the people of God. And every demon that has been assigned to make you cry, I prophesy that those demons are being chained in the name of Jesus. Every evil spirit that has been sent to torment your mind is being cast into the abyss right now. You are free. You are delivered. You are liberated in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Let me prophesy to somebody about relationships. You've been crying because of broken relationships. You've been weeping because of betrayal. Someone you trusted disappointed you. Someone you loved abandoned you. Someone you sacrificed for turned their back on you. And you've been asking God, why? Why did this happen to me? Why didn't you stop it? But here what the spirit of the Lord is saying. What you thought was rejection was actually divine redirection. God removed them because they were not supposed to be part of your next level. God disconnected you because that connection was going to limit your destiny. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:24, "There is a friend who sticks closer than a brother." God is bringing you into connections that will stick. He's bringing you into relationships that will last. He's bringing you into friendships that will add value. Those tears you cried because of broken relationships are about to turn into joy because of divine connections. God is connecting you to people who will honor you, celebrate you, support you, and push you into your purpose. The pain of disconnection is preparing you for the power of divine connection. Father, I pray for marriages that are in crisis. I pray for couples who have been crying because their homes are falling apart. Lord, you are the God who hates divorce. You are the God who instituted marriage. And I decree by prophetic authority that every marriage under attack is being restored right now. Every home that the enemy is trying to destroy is being rebuilt right now. I command the spirit of division to leave. I command the spirit of strife to depart. I command the spirit of unforgiveness to be broken. And I release the spirit of love. I release the spirit of peace. I release the spirit of unity. Hearts that have grown cold are being rekindled. Love that has faded is being restored. Communication that has broken down is being reestablished. And those who have been crying over their marriages will soon be celebrating their marriages. IN THE NAME OF JESUS, I want to talk to those who have been weeping over their children. You've been crying because your children are weward. You've been weeping because they've turned away from God. You've been in pain because they are making terrible decisions. You've been interceding in the midnight hour. You've been fasting and praying. You've been standing in the gap and it seems like nothing is changing. But hear me, your prayers have been heard. Your tears have reached heaven. Your intercession has not been in vain. The Bible says in Isaiah 49-25, "I will contend with him who contends with you, and I will save your children." And I prophesy to you this morning that God is arresting your children. God is apprehending them like he apprehended Saul on the road to Damascus. That child that has run away from God is being pursued by the Holy Spirit. That daughter who has wandered into sin is being drawn back by the cords of love. That son who has been making wrong choices is about to encounter God in a way that would change his life forever. I decree a turnaround. I decree a transformation. I decree a testimony. And the same children that made you cry will be the same children that will make you rejoice. They will stand before you and testify, "Mother, your prayer saved me. Father, your intercession rescued me. Glory to God." Now, I need you to understand something about the prophetic significance of tears. In the kingdom of God, tears have power. Your tears are not a sign of weakness. They are a weapon of warfare. When you cry out to God from a place of genuine brokenness, when your tears are mixed with faith, when you weep in the secret place before the throne of grace, something happens in the heavenly realm. Heaven responds to tears. The Bible records in 2 Kings 20 that when King Hezekiah wept before the Lord, God heard him before the prophet even left the palace. God said, "I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears." Your tears move the heart of God. When you cry, God doesn't look away. He draws closer. When you weep, God doesn't abandon you. He comforts you. When you're broken, God doesn't reject you. He heals you. And I prophesy to you this morning that every tear you've cried in secret is about to produce a public testimony. Every time you wept alone, God was there taking notes. He was documenting your pain. He was recording your sorrow. And now he's about to convert it into celebration. Father, I thank you because you said in Isaiah 61:3 that you give us beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. Lord, I pray for a divine exchange right now. Exchange their ashes for beauty. Exchange their mourning for joy. Exchange their heaviness for praise. Let them receive double for their trouble. Let them receive twice as much blessing for every tear they've cried. Let them receive supernatural compensation for every pain they've endured in the mighty name of Jesus. I want to prophesy over your business, over your career, over your finances. Some of you have been crying because everything you touch seems to fail. You've been weeping because your efforts are not producing results. You've been in tears because the harder you work, the less you see. But I hear the spirit of God saying that your season of fruitless labor is over. Your season of wasted effort is terminated. The Bible says in Haggi 1:6, you have sown much and bring in little. You eat but do not have enough. You drink but you are not filled with drink. You clothe yourselves but no one is warm. And he who earns wages earns wages to put into a bag with holes. But God said he was going to reverse that cause. I prophesy that the holes in your financial bag are being sealed right now. The leakages in your resources are being stopped. The divorce are being rebuked. Whatever has been consuming your blessings is being destroyed in the name of Jesus. And I decree that from this moment forward, your labor will produce results. Your efforts will yield returns. Your investments will bring profit. YOUR BUSINESSES WILL FLOURISH. YOUR careers will advance. And the same ventures that made you weep will be the same ventures that will make you wealthy. You will prosper. You will increase. YOU WILL EXPAND IN THE MIGHTY name of Jesus. Let me address those who have been crying because of delayed promises. God spoke to you years ago. He gave you a vision. He showed you a dream. He made you a promise. But years have passed and nothing has happened. You've been waiting and waiting and the wait has been painful. The delay has been discouraging. You've wondered if God forgot about you. You've questioned if you had him correctly. You've even doubted if the promise was real. But I want you to know this morning that delay is not denial. Just because it hasn't happened yet doesn't mean it won't happen at all. The Bible says in Habachuk 2:3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it will speak and it will not lie. Though it tries, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry." There is an appointed time. There is a set season. There is a divine moment when what God promised will manifest. And I prophesy to you that you are entering your appointed time. You are stepping into your set season. This is the year when the promise becomes reality. This is the month when the vision materializes. This is the week when what you've been waiting for suddenly appears. Father, I pray for the fulfillment of delayed promises. Everything you promise that has not yet manifested, let it manifest now. Every word you spoke that has not yet come to pass, let it COME TO PASS NOW. Every vision you gave that has not yet materialized, let it materialize now in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree acceleration. I decree supernatural speed. I decree divine urgency. What was supposed to take 10 years will happen in one year. What was supposed to take 12 months will happen in 1 month. What was supposed to take weeks will happen in days. God is accelerating your blessings. He's fasttracking your breakthroughs. He's speeding up your miracles. And those who made you weep because they said it would never happen will be the same people who will weep when they see it happen. They will be amazed. They will be shocked. They will be speechless when God does what only he can do in your life. I see somebody who has been crying because of shame and reproach. You've been carrying the weight of past mistakes. You've been haunted by failures. You've been tormented by regrets. People have mocked you, criticized you, judged you, and you've been living under a cloud of shame. But hear me clearly, the blood of Jesus has erased your past. The mercy of God has covered your mistakes. The grace of God has given you a new beginning. You are not defined by what you did yesterday. You are defined by what Christ did on the cross. The Bible says in Joel 2:25:26, "I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten. You shall eat in plenty and be satisfied. And praise the name of the Lord your God who has dealt wondrously with you. And my people shall never be put to shame. Never be put to shame. That's a promise. I prophesy that your days of shame are over. Your season of reproach is finished. God is restoring your dignity. He's returning your honor. He's rebuilding your reputation. And those who mocked you will apologize. Those who laughed at you will celebrate you. Those who wrote you off will write about you. Your testimony will silence your critics. Your breakthrough will shock your enemies. Your victory will amaze your doubters in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I pray for those carrying the burden of shame. Lift it off them right now. Remove the weight of past failures. Wash away the stain of yesterday's mistakes. Clothe them with your righteousness. Crown them with your glory. Let them walk with their heads lifted high because they know they are forgiven. They are accepted. They are loved. They are valued in the mighty name of Jesus. Let me speak to those who have been crying because of barness. And I'm not just talking about physical barness. Yes, there are women who have been weeping because they've been unable to conceive. But there are also people with baring businesses, baring ministries, baring careers, baring marriages, baring dreams. You've been laboring, but there's been no fruit. You've been walking, but there's been no harvest. You've been sewing, but there's been no increase. But I prophesy to you this morning that your season of barness is over. The God who opened the womb of Sarah, the God who gave Hannah a son, the God who caused the Shunomite woman to conceive, the God who made Elizabeth pregnant in her own age, that same God is visiting you right now. I decree fruitfulness. I decree multiplication. I decree productivity. Whatever has been barren in your life is about to become fruitful. That barren womb will conceive. That barren business will produce profit. That barren ministry will bear fruit. That barren career will bring promotion. I command every seed that has been planted to germinate. I command every effort that has been made to yield returns. You will not be barren. You will be fruitful in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, before I finish this prayer, I want you to do something. I want you to wipe your tears. I want you to lift up your head. I want you to open your mouth and begin to thank God for what he's about to do. Don't wait until you see it. Praise him now. Don't wait until it manifests. Worship him now. Your praise is prophetic. Your worship is a weapon. When you praise God in the midst of pain, you're declaring that he's bigger than your problem. When you worship him while you're weeping, you're proclaiming that his promises are more powerful than your present situation. The Bible says in Acts 16 that when Paul and Silas were in prison, beaten and bruised, instead of complaining, they prayed and sang praises to God. And at midnight, while they were praising, there was a great earthquake. And the foundations of the prison were shaken. And immediately all the doors were opened. Your praise is about to shake the foundations of that prison. Your worship is about to open those locked doors. Your thanksgiving is about to trigger your breakthrough. So lift up your voice right now and say, "Father, I thank you. I thank you for turning my tears into joy. I thank you for turning my sorrow into celebration. I thank you for turning my pain into purpose. I thank you because what the enemy meant for evil, you are turning for my good. I thank you because you are making all things work together for my benefits. I thank you because my latter shall be greater than my former. I thank you because my best days are ahead of me. I thank you because my breakthrough is imminent. I thank you because my miracle is on the way. I thank you because my testimony is loading. I thank you. I praise you. I worship you in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I decree that every word spoken is established in heaven and manifested on earth. I decree that from this day forward, tears of sorrow are being converted into tears of joy. I decree that mourning is being turned into dancing. I decree that heaviness is being exchanged for praise. And I prophesy that before this year ends, everyone who has prayed this prayer will have a testimony. They will stand and declare, "God turned my tears into joy. He turned my weeping into dancing. He turned my sorrow into celebration. What he promised, he has performed. What he spoke, he has fulfilled. I am a living testimony of the faithfulness of God. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I have prayed." And every believer who has agreed with this prayer, let them say a resounding amen. Amen. Amen. Now go and share this prayer. Send it to someone who needs to hear it. Post it where broken hearts can find it. Share it in every place where people are weeping. Because this is not just a prayer. This is a prophetic declaration that will change lives, transform situations, and turn tears into testimonies of joy. Glory to the name of Jesus. Hallelujah.
